#TechLeadAtAdTechCo #CloudCostOptimizationPro #KubernetesEnthusiast #RESTAPIDesignMaster #SystemDesignSavant  

I build scalable adtech platforms that outperform the competition. As a Tech Lead at AdTechCo, I architect solutions that balance innovation with operational excellence—because speed isn’t enough, it has to be smart.  

Leading Scrum teams through complex sprints? My jam. I’ve delivered 10+ projects on time, even when the requirements were as vague as a client’s coffee order. Cloud cost optimization? I’ve slashed budgets by 30% without sacrificing performance—talk about ROI.  

Cross-team collaboration is my superpower. Recently, I aligned engineering with marketing and data teams to deploy a real-time bidding system that boosted ad throughput by 40%. And let’s not forget Kubernetes—my playground for orchestrating microservices that scale like wildfire.  

Mentoring junior engineers? Absolutely. I’ve turned raw talent into rockstars, one code review at a time. Technical writing? I document architecture decisions so even my caffeine-fueled teammates can follow along.  

Terraform? I automate infrastructure like it’s a Monday morning—effortless, reliable, and always ahead of the curve. Let’s build something legendary.
